title: 2026-10-31_Okiru_Worm_Investigation_a1d
description: Investigate the Okiru worm, a variant of the Mirai malware family, in your network. Identify affected hosts and contain the threat.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The Okiru worm, a variant of the Mirai malware family, has been detected in your network. This worm targets ARC processors based Linux devices and uses exploits to propagate itself. Your task is to investigate the infection, identify the affected hosts, and contain the threat.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content: Access the sandbox via the provided cloud environment. Use the username 'admin' and password 'admin' to proceed to training levels. Enter the passkey 'start' to proceed to training levels.
levels.local_content: Instructions for local sandbox usage. Use the username 'admin' and password 'admin' to proceed to training levels. Enter the passkey 'start' to proceed to training levels.

levels.title: Identify Suspicious Service
levels.content: Identify and investigate an unauthorized or suspicious service running on the compromised host. Enumerate running services and distinguish legitimate services from worm-related services.
levels.solution: Check the status of all services and look for any that seem unusual or unauthorized. The worm-related service is likely named 'sysnet-monitor'.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check the status of all services and look for any that seem unusual or unauthorized.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for services related to network monitoring or system core monitoring.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Use the command 'systemctl list-units --type=service' to list all services.

levels.title: Determine Scheduled Task
levels.content: Determine whether a scheduled task or timer is responsible for automatically executing the worm. Identify scheduled execution persistence mechanisms.
levels.solution: Investigate the systemd timers and services. The worm uses a timer named 'sysnet-monitor.timer' to execute itself periodically.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Investigate the systemd timers and services.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for timers related to network monitoring or system core monitoring.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Use the command 'systemctl list-timers' to list all timers.

levels.title: Locate Worm Files
levels.content: Locate files installed by the worm on the compromised host. Correlate suspicious activity with malware artifacts stored on disk.
levels.solution: Search for hidden directories and unusual files. The worm files are located in the directory '/opt/.worm'.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Search for hidden directories and unusual files.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for directories named '.worm' or similar.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Use the command 'ls -la /opt' to list hidden directories in the /opt directory.
